title: clinopodium inodorum
intro: Clinopodium inodorum, commonly known as sweet woodruff, is a perennial flowering plant in the mint family. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of sweet woodruff include its sedative and antispasmodic effects, making it useful for treating insomnia and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Clinopodium inodorum include coumarins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
